scam.body: A friend sent you a $50 Steam gift card. Log in to redeem it: https://steamcommunlty-gift.com/redeem

scam.name: Walmart survey
scam.subject: You've been selected for a $500 gift card
scam.body: Complete a quick survey about your recent shopping experience to claim your $500 Walmart gift card. Just pay shipping: https://rebrand.ly/wmt500

scam.name: Utility shutoff phone
scam.subject: Final notice: disconnection today
scam.body: Your electricity will be disconnected in 2 hours due to an unpaid balance of $412. Call +1-888-555-0177 immediately to make a payment.

scam.name: Unclaimed inheritance
scam.subject: Inheritance of $7.5 million
scam.body: I am contacting you about the estate of a late client who shares your surname. The sum of $7,500,000 is unclaimed. Reply to proceed with the transfer.
